diagnosis: The aged population still arrests although it retains 3-, 4-, 5-, 7-, 8-, and 9-neighbor grains. The local eta>0 rate mask prevents a globally active phase from advancing into an adjacent exactly-zero pixel, numerically pinning neighbor switches. This is not accepted as physical stagnation.
corrective_action: Dilate each globally active phase's local update support by one finite-difference stencil cell. Retain irreversible global extinction, so the change enables local topology transitions without permitting an extinct grain to nucleate remotely.
